{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "Sjors",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "supportive of testing against recent Taproot-heavy blocks and offered to provide an assumeutxo snapshot"
    },
    {
      "login": "0xB10C",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "benchmarked IBD showing batch validation was slower than master"
    },
    {
      "login": "willcl-ark",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "collaborated on benchmarks and noted lack of fallback mechanism in early WIP"
    },
    {
      "login": "andrewtoth",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected to shared batch mutex contention and suggested per-thread batches"
    },
    {
      "login": "Eunovo",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "pointed out shared batch lock contention, verification inside critical sections, and ignored pubkey parse return values"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:1968590438",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "how batches are collected up to max_batch_size before calling batch.Verify()",
      "quote": "Is the current PR already using batches? It's unclear to me by glancing over validation.cpp if and how it's collecting up to max_batch_size{106} signatures before calling batch.Verify().",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "fjahr explained the batching mechanism and Sjors confirmed it clarified things",
      "author_replies": ["c:1968923056", "c:1968959800"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:1969001095",
      "status_by_quote": "That clarifies a lot, and should be documented :-)"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:1968590438",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "add a -schnorrbatchverify startup argument so more people can try it",
      "quote": "Maybe add a `-schnorrbatchverify` startup argument so more people can try it once it gets through review.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "fjahr agreed and considered adding a startup argument or compiler flag",
      "author_replies": ["c:1968923056"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:1968923056",
      "status_by_quote": "Yeah, I have been thinking that or maybe even a compiler argument"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:1969001095",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "document how batch verification and signature collection works",
      "quote": "That clarifies a lot, and should be documented :-)",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:2106968575",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "batch validation caused significant performance regressions during IBD compared to master",
      "quote": "master is currently faster... after taproot activation, batch validation is significantly slower than non-batch validation",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author implemented optimizations including batch per thread and verification outside critical sections",
      "author_replies": ["c:2889288127"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:2889288127",
      "status_by_quote": "I have implemented this and see a performance boost from it for the case with 15 worker threads"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:2525335080",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "holding a shared batch mutex during addition and verifying on the main thread negated multithreading benefits",
      "quote": "m_batch_mutex is held for the entirety of adding, which will cause lock contention. Verify is then a blocking call on the main thread, which negates the multithreading.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author implemented per-thread batches verified at the end of block checks",
      "author_replies": ["rc:2004525996", "rc:2009282526"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2009282526",
      "status_by_quote": "I have now implemented it with a batch per thread using a flag set in complete as you suggested."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:1997877541",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "sharing a single batch across threads caused worker threads to block waiting for batch access",
      "quote": "All the threads still share this batch. That means we still have the same locking problem; threads will be stuck waiting for the batch to be free.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author implemented per-thread batches",
      "author_replies": ["rc:2004525996", "rc:2009282526"],
      "other_replies": ["rc:2004559393"],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2009282526",
      "status_by_quote": "I have now implemented it with a batch per thread using a flag set in complete as you suggested."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:2851542917",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "performing batch verification inside the critical section caused throughput to degrade as thread count increased",
      "quote": "Doing batch-verification work within the critical section",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author moved batch verification outside the critical section and benchmarked speedup",
      "author_replies": ["c:2889288127"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:2965616244",
      "status_by_quote": "It seems like the major reason for performance drop was the batch-verification work being performed in the critical section."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2148806441",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "discarding the return value of pubkey parsing risks ignoring invalid public keys",
      "quote": "why discard the return value of secp256k1_xonly_pubkey_parse()?",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated the code to check the return value in a later push",
      "author_replies": ["rc:2727489972"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2727489972",
      "status_by_quote": "Not discarding it anymore in the latest push."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:1968590438",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "highlighted potential performance benefits on recent Taproot-heavy mainnet blocks and offered an assumeutxo snapshot to facilitate testing",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": ["validation.cpp"]
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:1997499892",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "noted the architecture sets up well for future batch taproot tweak verification",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": ["src/script/sigcache.h"]
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Reread the discussion under schema 2: captured Sjors's initial question and suggestions regarding batching and configuration, and re-evaluated clears_with on performance defects. The PR remains an experimental draft awaiting reviewer benchmarks on the latest rebase.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "review and benchmarks of the rebased branch",
      "id": "c:6519391545"
    }
  ]
}
